verdict.rationale: Windmill documents AI Agent steps that run directly inside flows and connect to various AI providers and models, which covers the in-workflow LLM step and model choice. The evidence does not document tool use by those agent steps. The MCP docs describe external LLM clients triggering Windmill scripts, which is a different capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented tool/function calling within AI agent steps, depth on model selection configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use

citations.quote: AI Agents steps allow you to integrate AI agents directly into your Windmill flows. They provide an interface to connect with various AI providers and models
